interior_flavor: Nothing there. Quench water and hammer scale, under a wall of work that all passed.
Nothing there. Scorch marks where the tongs get set down.

floor_layers._pick: The forge annex shares the tier's neutral cobbled flags; work surfaces and furnace light carry the room, not blue brick.

decor._light_comment: v0.17 R2: a forge hall with no light in it. Same molten flicker its pallass_forge twin carries. ONE of the two stations on purpose -- a matched pair reads as a decal. Count 0 -> 1.

entities.observe: The hall door, propped with a wedge nobody has ever removed. Past it, the tier's noise resumes.

entities._comment: P1 SKILL route. requires_skill renders VISIBLE-LOCKED: a player without the arm still sees the route and takes TALK or FIGHT.
entities.observe: A billet clamped mid-process, two quench barrels beside it, a gauge still reading where the last failure left it.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Colour and quench you can read off the billet yourself. The count between them takes a trained eye — appraise it and the numbers come clear.
entities.locked_toast: The gauge on the bench is reading in marks you do not know. Setting the count by guess would spoil the billet and the week of work in it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Goods] — You read the grain off the colour, set the fast oil aside for the slow barrel, and quench. On the jig, the billet comes back to the second notch.

entities.observe: A steel jig on a stand, two notches filed into its arm. The examiner's seal is stamped into the base.
entities.toast: The jig bends a blade to the first notch and lets go. The mark that counts is the second notch, where the blade comes back to.

entities.observe: A young Drake with her sleeves pinned back and a scorch on one forearm she has not stopped working long enough to notice.
entities.friendly_line: She looks up for exactly as long as the count allows, then back down. Her lips are moving on a number.
talk_pool: Third year. Third year is when they stop telling you what you did wrong and start writing it down.
I can make it hard. Anyone can make it hard. Making it come back is the part.
Mind the tub, {addr}. It looks still until it isn't.
The smith says the bench is hers till second bell. She also says that at third bell.

entities.observe: A scum ring runs right around the inside of the tub three fingers above the water: below it, grey with scale under an unbroken skin of oil.
entities.toast: You touch the surface. Warm all the way down, and this tub has not been cold in years. The oil skin closes back over where your finger went.

entities.observe: A slate ruled into columns: heat, count, quench, result. The result column is chalked over so many times the surface has gone soft.
entities.toast: Forty-one attempts. Under the last one, in smaller writing than the rest: TRY THE OTHER WAY ROUND.

entities.observe: A grid of finished pieces the width of the wall, one to a slot: a wired civic tag on each, smith's mark and measure, no price.
entities.toast: Every piece on the wall passed. You count the tags: four different smiths, four different answers, one standard.

entities._comment: P1 FIGHT. INTERACT-ONLY -- never add trigger_radius (it would ambush the TALK/SKILL routes; encounter_when gate is mutation-proven by pallass_depth_gates_check). Banks golem_recalibrated ONLY, never forge_golems_culled.
entities.observe: A squat rig on three legs, gauges banked along its front, correcting its own posture a half-beat after it needs to.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The rig overshoots its marks and settles wrong, then does it again while you watch. The smith has not asked you to put a hand on it.

entities._comment: #513 tempered_standards re-theme: the examiner on screen, a Dullahan bend-tester at his jig (canon within the bar: Dullahan smiths in Pallass, Maughin and Lorent, 6.09). Unnamed civic role. Owned rig `dullahan_examiner` (#603), faced down because his side view hides the head (docs/design/513-pallass-art.md). (8,2) sits east of the jig, off the hall's scripted lanes ((7,3) jig approach, row 7, (4,3) bench, (8,6) rig) and off the journeys' only hall cell (5,7). talk_pool only: the quest's routes stay on the jig, the bench and the rig.
entities.observe: A Dullahan in dark plate, his head carried at his hip under one arm and a blade held point-down in the other hand.
entities.friendly_line: He tips the head under his arm a few degrees toward you and holds it there a moment.
talk_pool: Stand clear of the jig, please. A blade that lets go can travel.
I hold my head out level with the edge so I can sight along it. You may stop looking at it now.
My seal goes on the tag, or the blade goes in her bin. I do not argue a reading, with the smith or anyone.

lines: Her blades come back to the second notch now. I sealed four of them this morning.
